A Legacy of Artisanal Mastery

Over 26 Years of Engineering & Crafting Luxury Furniture in Riyadh

AlMuqrin Furniture & Decor Factory was founded on an unyielding commitment to set benchmark standards in bespoke commercial joinery, architectural paneling, and presidential executive furniture across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

We merge time-honored artisanal joinery with German ultra-precision digital machinery (Homag & Biesse 5-Axis CNC) to fulfill the exacting expectations of royal residences, corporate towers, and premier institutional developments.

Advanced CAD/CAM Parametric Engineering

Precise stress-load simulations ensuring decades of structural integrity.

Full Compliance with Saudi SASO Standards

Kiln-dried hardwoods stabilized against extreme regional climatic swings.

Turnkey Execution from Blueprint to Installation

Factory-owned fleet and certified white-glove site installation teams.

Industrial Precision & German Tech

Our End-to-End Manufacturing Workflow

From raw certified timber to architectural masterpieces across 8 rigorous stages.

Explore Factory Machinery
ALMUQRIN FACTORY • مصنع المقرن
01

Premium Timber Sourcing & Kiln Seasoning

We source certified Grade-A natural hardwoods (American Walnut, European Oak, Mahogany) and stabilize moisture content to 8-10% inside computer-controlled kiln-drying chambers suited for Saudi Arabia's arid climate.

Automated Italian kiln chambers & precision digital hygrometers
ALMUQRIN FACTORY • مصنع المقرن
02

Digital CAD/CAM Parametric Engineering

Our technical architects convert architectural shop drawings into 3D parametric CAD models and simulate stress loads and mechanical joinery tolerances before cutting.

SolidWorks & Alphacam advanced parametric engineering suites
ALMUQRIN FACTORY • مصنع المقرن
03

5-Axis CNC Precision Cutting & Milling

Ultra-high precision profiling, boring, and carving executed by 5-axis Homag and Biesse CNC centers with tolerances under 0.1mm, ensuring seamless assembly fit.

German Homag Centateq & Italian Biesse 5-Axis Rover CNC Centers
ALMUQRIN FACTORY • مصنع المقرن
04

Master Joinery & Hand-Crafted Assembly

Master woodcrafters hand-fit joints using time-tested mortise & tenon and dovetail joinery alongside thermosetting structural adhesives resistant to extreme climates.

Hydraulic squaring presses & high-clamping structural rigs
